name: Izumi
source:
A close friend of the player and a little-sister figure to Hiroshi, Izumi has since moved on from her unrequited feelings for Kenshi. 

[spoiler]Midway through the story, she goes missing. She is eventually found with the help of Yumiko, where she and Jun spent time together romantically. She eventually becomes Jun's girlfriend.[/spoiler]
translation:
A close friend of the player and a little-sister figure to Hiroshi, Izumi has since moved on from her unrequited feelings for Kenshi. 

[spoiler]Midway through the story, she goes missing. She is eventually found with the help of Yumiko, where she and Jun spent time together romantically. She eventually becomes Jun's girlfriend.[/spoiler]
